info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: The Product Expert Sales Support API facilitates the retrieval of specific sales data based on a given parameter. This endpoint allows users to access detailed information regarding sales for products, helping businesses analyze performance and customer engagement. Typical consumers include sales analysts and business intelligence teams looking to optimize sales strategies. By leveraging this API, developers can easily integrate this sales data into their applications for insightful reporting and decision-making.

get.summary: Retrieve sales support details for a specific product.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch comprehensive sales support information for the product identified by PROD-700045. It includes details on features, pricing, and availability, helping customers make informed purchasing decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve detailed information and support for the specified product. Ensure that the request adheres to the expected format to receive accurate and relevant responses.
